issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' produces wrong pixels when PIL decodes as RGBA or palette mode
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNGs that PIL opens in whatever mode the file declares (RGBA, P, L). Calling tobytes() without conversion while declaring format='RGB' violates the frame contract and produces a buffer of wrong size and layout. Convert explicitly with image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(). Will crash or render garbage downstream.

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is a shipped 'temporary hack'
issues.detail: Mutating a private underscore-prefixed attribute of google-genai at module import creates a global side effect for every consumer in the process and will silently break when the attribute is renamed. File an upstream fix, pin the version, or use a supported API to set the buffer size. Do not ship self-confessed hacks as load-bearing imports.

issues.description: Default model silently bumped from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash inside a feature PR
issues.detail: Every caller relying on the default now gets different cost, latency, and behavior on next deploy. This belongs in a separate PR with a migration note, not folded into image-generation work. CHANGELOG mention is insufficient; the coupling also makes the change harder to revert independently.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is a fragile capability proxy
issues.detail: `if 'image' in self._model_name` will match any future model with 'image' anywhere in its name, including non-generation models like gemini-X-image-understanding. Replace with an explicit capability table or _is_image_model() method backed by a known set, so the thinking-budget rule rests on a real predicate rather than vendor naming coincidence.

issues.description: No size bound or error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server-returned bytes
issues.detail: inline_data.data is read unconditionally into BytesIO and PIL with no try/except, no MIME-type check, and no upper bound. A malformed payload raises UnidentifiedImageError and kills the entire _process_context loop; an oversized payload exhausts memory. Wrap in try/except, log, validate mime_type, and continue processing remaining parts.

issues.description: Gratuitous blank line in __init__ adds diff noise unrelated to the patch
issues.detail: Line 717 inserts a blank line between self._http_options and self._create_client with no other change nearby. Doesn't match surrounding style and hints that image handling was bolted on rather than extracted into a small helper. Drop it; keep the diff scoped to what the patch needs.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK with two P0 blockers: an image-frame contract violation (PIL bytes labeled RGB without conversion, breaking on RGBA/palette PNGs) and a self-confessed 'temporary hack' that monkey-patches a private google-genai attribute at module import. Three P1 issues follow: the default-model bump from 2.0 to 2.5 is a silent breaking change piggybacked on the feature, image-model capability is detected by fragile substring match, and there is no error path or size bound on inline image bytes. Fix the image conversion, find a supported way to set the buffer size, split the default-model change into its own PR, and replace the substring sniff with an explicit capability check.
